original_test_intent: Demonstrate platform endurance and deterministic recovery through 1000 full AC cycles, 1000 approved DC cycles and 1000 warm reboots, proving after every transition that all expected PCIe, NVSwitch/fabric, power-sequencing, BMC-scope I2C and HMC-BMC USB resources return in their approved state without new errors.
original_method: Define three non-interchangeable reset phases and exact primitives, power domains, dwell and readiness deadlines; bind the full GPU/NIC/DPU/SSD/switch/retimer PCIe topology and speed/width oracle, NVSwitch MST/fabric oracle, rail sequencing contract, BMC controller/bus/address I2C map and HMC-BMC USB path; validate one dry run of each phase; execute an abortable transaction per numbered cycle with operator-gated AC action and secure DC/reboot control; capture every cross-domain result before the next transition and terminate on first deviation without log clearing or retry.
manual_activity: Authorized operators isolate the rack power domain, supervise each AC/PDU action and recovery, validate the physical HMC-BMC connection, and own any failed boot, power-sequence or hardware recovery.
required_inputs: Approved PDU/outlet and AC-loss procedure, exact DC-cycle primitive/power domains, exact warm-reboot primitive, all dwell and readiness deadlines
Stable identity and expected state matrix for every PCIe endpoint/path, NVSwitch/MST/fabric device, power rail/sequence, BMC I2C controller/bus/address endpoint and HMC-BMC USB path
Secure BMC/PDU/console access, approved read-only domain tools, large durable per-cycle evidence storage and watchdog/abort control
3000-cycle maintenance authorization, dry-run approval, zero/error tolerances, first-fault rule and multidisciplinary recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated drained SUT and verify the exact PDU outlet and power domains before actions
Keep AC operator-gated; use secure secret handling and bounded state transitions for DC and warm reboot
Use only the vendor-approved non-destructive BMC/OOB I2C scan; never probe unknown buses or addresses
Preserve all logs and first-fault state; do not use clearing or retries to obtain a clean cycle
Stop on any boot/readiness timeout, missing/downtrained device, fabric mismatch, power-sequence fault, I2C/USB loss, error burst, thermal/power issue or lost console/BMC/PDU control
agent_execution_scope: Validate the three reset primitives, dry runs, topology/oracles, interlocks, storage and recovery
Coordinate approved operator AC actions and automate only bounded secure DC/reboot transitions and read-only checks
Persist a complete immutable cycle record before permitting the next transition
Do not batch blindly, probe unspecified I2C paths, hide errors, retry a failed cycle or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve AC/DC/warm-reboot definitions, ordering, counts, dwell/readiness and phase boundaries
Approve every PCIe/fabric/power/I2C/USB identity and acceptance oracle plus evidence retention
Approve first-fault and multidisciplinary recovery, then review all 3000 records and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its IPMI chassis cycle addresses only part of the DC phase and embeds unsafe access; it neither performs the required AC/warm-reboot phases nor validates the complete post-cycle domains.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an owner-approved abortable three-phase controller only after one successful dry run per primitive; require a complete target-bound cross-domain evidence transaction after every numbered cycle before advancing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 1000 AC cycles, 1000 DC cycles, 1000 warm reboots, all named PCIe/fabric/power/I2C/USB checks, no bundle, and 60/30000-minute allocation remain; no cycle count or domain is reduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model each cycle as an atomic state transition with pre-state, approved action, observable power/reset boundary, bounded recovery, complete cross-domain oracle and durable commit before the next action.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds distinct phase semantics, dry runs, stable identity matrices, complete per-cycle coverage, secure controls, automatic hard stop and coordinated recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A phase summary or final snapshot can hide transient device loss, downtraining, sequence faults, disappearing I2C/USB endpoints and the exact cycle that introduced persistent degradation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Three thousand disruptive transitions impose substantial electrical, mechanical, storage and availability stress across the whole HGX platform; control or evidence failure invalidates continued unattended execution.

project_override_considerations: No phase may substitute for another. Existing subtests EC.13/14/15 can contribute only if they use the identical approved primitives and their complete per-cycle artifacts are traceably incorporated; they cannot reduce the 1000-cycle requirement without a separate approved decision.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner approvals, SUT/rack/PDU/BMC identity, tool versions and three dry-run records
1000 numbered AC, 1000 numbered DC and 1000 numbered warm-reboot action/state/readiness records
For every cycle, complete expected PCIe inventory/path/speed/width and AER state plus NVSwitch MST/IB/Ethernet topology and counters
Per-cycle approved power-sequence evidence, BMC/OOB I2C endpoint map and HMC-BMC USB endpoint/path/speed state
Per-cycle dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL, thermal/power and error deltas with durable timestamps and artifact hashes
First-fault/recovery package or verified final state after all 3000 cycles and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, detailed Procedure and Criteria consistently define three endurance phases and the same cross-domain recovery checks. Missing primitives, maps and thresholds are execution specifications, not competing source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The complete endurance objective and named domains are clear. Equipment, exact controls and domain oracles are substantial but supplyable prerequisites, so static review can complete without declaring an irreducible blocker.

review_improvement: Transforms an insecure DC-only loop and final post-check into a faithful, abortable 3000-transition platform endurance protocol with complete per-cycle coverage for every named domain.
independent_technical_reasoning: AC loss, DC/S5 transition and warm reboot exercise different initialization state and cannot be pooled. A platform may recover at cycle 1001 while losing one retimer, I2C endpoint or USB path at cycle 437, so acceptance requires a stable identity oracle and complete evidence before the next transition overwrites transient state. Because unknown I2C probing can itself alter platform-management devices, the scan must use the approved BMC controller/bus/address method rather than a generic host sweep. The first mismatch ends the sequence: additional cycles would destroy diagnostic state and add stress after acceptance has already failed.
